title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 23 ]

items.text: Remember me to your wife.
alternatives: Please remember me to your wife.
Remember me to your wife, please.

items.text: Say hello to your wife for me.
alternatives: Say hi to your wife for me.
Please say hello to your wife for me.
Say hello to your wife for me, please.

items.text: Give my regards to your wife.
alternatives: Give your wife my regards.
Please give my regards to your wife.
Please give your wife my regards.

items.text: Tell her we miss her very much.
alternatives: Tell her we miss her so much.
Tell her we miss her a lot.

items.text: How would you like your coffee?
alternatives: How do you want your coffee?
How do you like your coffee?

items.text: Help yourself to the dessert.
alternatives: Help yourself to dessert.
Please help yourself to the dessert.
Please help yourself to dessert.

items.text: I am sorry I am late.
alternatives: Sorry I'm late.

items.text: I am sorry I didn't take your advice seriously.
alternatives: Sorry I didn't take your advice seriously.

items.text: Don't take it too hard.
alternatives: Don't take that too hard.
Don't take it so hard.

items.text: I would like to take your measurements.
alternatives: I want to take your measurements.

items.text: She is very fussy about clothes.
alternatives: She is extremely fussy about clothes.
She is really fussy about clothes.
She is so fussy about clothes.
She is very particular about clothes.
She is very picky about clothes.

items.text: What's your ancestry?
Freeze!
After you, please.
alternatives: After you.
Please, after you.

items.text: You really take after your father.
I was named after him.
alternatives: I was named for him.

items.text: What are your New Year's resolutions?
alternatives: What is your New Year's resolution?
What are your New Year resolutions?

items.text: Are you through with your meal?
alternatives: Are you through with the meal?

items.text: Is this restaurant open seven days a week?
alternatives: Is this restaurant open 7 days a week?
Is this restaurant open seven days per week?

items.text: It is open Monday through Friday.
alternatives: That is open Monday through Friday.
It is open from Monday to Friday.
It is open Monday to Friday.
